patients.clinical_remarks: Patient presents with irregular cycles, treatment-resistant acne, and clinical hirsutism. Transvaginal ultrasound confirms bilateral polycystic ovary morphology with antral follicle counts showing classical string-of-pearls arrangement.

Patient presents with fatigue, weight gain, irregular cycles, and mild acne. Metabolic assessment indicates severe insulin resistance. Ovarian morphology is borderline, but clinical presentation is dominated by metabolic features.

All clinical biomarkers and hormone panels reside within normal reference ranges. Menstrual cycles are regular. Ovarian ultrasound demonstrates healthy follicular distribution. No clinical signs of hyperandrogenism.
